title: Part History search finds entries by their text or staff name, in any case
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a part, part A, for this test, then deactivate it with the note Superseded Kit, reactivate it with no note and turn its tracking off, so its Part History holds those three entries from you.
  • Start on part A's Part History page (the clock icon at the left of its row).
custom_steps:
1. Type superseded kit in the Part History search.
  2. Replace the text with TRACKING TURNED.
  3. Replace the text with your first name in lower case.
  4. Clear the search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Only "Deactivated | Reason: Superseded Kit" is listed.

Step 2:

  • Only "Tracking turned off" is listed.

Step 3:

  • Every entry you made on part A is listed: a Staff name match counts too.

Step 4:

  • All of part A's entries are back.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R27: “The Part History search finds an entry when the typed text appears in its Event text as shown on screen, or in its Staff name. Upper and lower case do not matter. This applies to every kind of entry.”
